visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Center Is Counted Twice
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Both diagonals together sum to 24 when the center element 5 is counted only once, but the program prints 29.

solution.explanation: In an odd-sized matrix both diagonals pass through the center, so its value would be added twice. The test i != 2 - i skips the anti-diagonal element when it is the same cell as the main-diagonal one.
